notes.title: Major update: Steam achievements, Global leaderboard and improved visual FX!
notes.content:
SpinZap now supports Steam achievements, a Global leaderboard and has been updated with new visual effects.

Have fun, and may the best player top the leaderboard!

notes.title: Coming soon: Steam achievements, Steam leaderboard and improved visual FX!
notes.content:
Work is currently ongoing to implement Steam achievements, a Steam leaderboard and improved visual effects in SpinZap. 

All this will be released in the near future.

In the meantime, you may notice that achievements (which you cannot unlock) show up in the Steam client. You will be able to unlock them as soon as the new game build is released. The same goes for the leaderboard - your scores will not be uploaded until the new version is released.

notes.title: SpinZap now supports Remote Play Together
notes.content:
Remote Play Together has been added to SpinZap's Steam configuration. 

Beat the most punishing levels together!

Have fun!
